seo.title: Jordan Reyes Sponsorship Portal
seo.description: Choose a logo placement on Jordan Reyes's fight trunks and T-shirt.
seo.ogTitle: Sponsor Jordan Reyes · Fight Night · Nov 12
seo.ogDescription: Explore the 360° model, bid from $250 or lock a placement for $1,500.
seo.twitterDescription: Explore the 360° model, bid from $250 or lock a placement for $1,500.

hero.intro: Rotate Jordan to explore every available placement. Switch apparel, select a position, and preview your logo.

benefits: Your logo on Jordan Reyes's fight trunks or T-shirt at Fight Night

copy.privacyNote: Upload a logo before you bid and it is saved with your bid, then shown on the placement once it is locked or won. Final artwork is confirmed personally.

copy.invoiceFooter: Includes the full Fight Night package: fight apparel logo placement, social media promotion, post-fight interview shout-out, branded media kit, and two VIP ringside tickets.
